fields.body:

- object SHA.

`refs/codex/turn-diffs/*`

fields.heading: ## END_REF_SNAPSHOT
fields.body:

- `ADDED`
- `REMOVED`
- `MOVED`
- `UNCHANGED`

If provenance/owner cannot be proven:

`OWNER_UNVERIFIED`

Do not infer ownership from naming.
